listing.title: AlphaVoice Studio
listing.shortDescription: Professional local voice cloning, voice design, dubbing and dictation studio.
listing.description: AlphaVoice Studio is a professional local-first desktop studio for voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, transcription and real-time dictation. Audio and projects remain securely on the user's computer by default, with no mandatory cloud accounts or external API keys required.

minimumOs.linux: Distribution supported by the selected package format

permissions.microphone: Record reference speech and provide real-time dictation when the user starts those features.
permissions.accessibility: Insert user-requested dictation into the focused application when the user enables this integration.
permissions.files: Open user-selected media and save generated audio, video and project files.
